devdoc.details: An ENS registrar that allows the owner of a DNS name to claim the      corresponding name in ENS. Inception times are stored per name per type with a hash of the record data:     `uint256 hash := (uint256(keccak256(data)) << 32) + uint32(inception)`

DNSDecodingFailed(bytes).details: The DNS-encoded name is malformed.      Error selector: `0xba4adc23`

params.inception: Inception time of the "_ens.{name}" record, in seconds.
params.name: DNS-encoded name.

params.previousRegistrars: Addresses of previous DNSRegistrars. The first should the prior DNSRegistrar.

inceptions(bytes32).details: Corresponds to the TXT record of "_ens.{name}".  The inception time from  `getInception("_ens.{name}", 16)` is equivalent to `inceptions(namehash(name))`.

params.input: A chain of signed DNS RRSETs ending with a text record.
params.name: DNS-encoded name to claim.

params.input: A chain of signed DNS RRSETs ending with a text record.
params.name: DNS-encoded name to claim.

_inceptions.details: Mapping from `(node, typeCovered)` to the last hashed inception.

wasRegistrar.details: Mapping to check if registrar was a DNSRegistrar deployment.

StaleProof(bytes,uint16,uint32,bytes28,u.notice: Proof for `name` was stale and the records were different.

InceptionUpdated(bytes32,uint16,bytes,ui.notice: A claim updated a stored inception.

getInception(bytes,uint16).notice: Get the latest inception time and hash of a claim by record type.

inceptions(bytes32).notice: Get the latest inception time of a claim.

proveAndClaim(bytes,(bytes,bytes)[]).notice: Verify proofs with DNSSEC oracle, claim the name, and call `setSubnodeOwner()`.

proveAndClaimWithResolver(bytes,(bytes,b.notice: Verify proofs with DNSSEC oracle, claim the name, and call `setSubnodeRecord()`.
